title.purpose: Default section headings in the reading face.

shadows.name: border
shadows.purpose: Shallow structural depth on buttons, general/form cards, replay content and empty states; not job links, detail or Operations panels.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Declared stylesheet token; no current transition uses it.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: First unqualified session visit only; skipped for reduced motion, reported <=2 logical processors, Save-Data and slow-2g/2g/3g; cancelled by keyboard, hidden document or page exit.

motion.name: sequence
motion.value: 650ms per step; 1200ms rapid-activation guard; 150ms opacity and 200ms transform transitions
motion.purpose: Optional highlight only. Second activation, keyboard/reduced-motion activation and cancellation settle immediately; all text remains available.

motion.name: pointer-press
motion.purpose: Fine pointer only; touch, keyboard and reduced motion have no press transform.

narrative.overview:
CrewCast combines the clarity of a dispatch manifest with an explanatory weather bulletin. Ink anchors the frame, signal yellow identifies the example comparison and explanatory notes, and cobalt identifies actions. Condensed, bold headings give the product a clear voice; spacious reading text keeps the evidence usable.

The visual system separates a job's work window, recommendation reason and evidence age without implying occupational-safety clearance. Structural rules, aligned intervals and textual statuses carry meaning. Content remains available before enhancement; motion adds emphasis without delaying access.
keyCharacteristics: Bold condensed headings with a calm reading face.
Yellow explanation surfaces, ink structure and cobalt actions.
Whole job records with visible work windows, reasons and evidence age.
Restrained rounded controls and flat, ruled operational records.
Optional, cancellable motion with immediate keyboard and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status color supports the displayed recommendation and freshness language; it never replaces either.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep operational records, detail and Operations panels flat and ruled; reserve the shared shallow shadow for the implemented controls and rounded containers.

dos: Do pair status colors with visible wording, reasons and evidence age.
Do use Barlow Condensed for expressive headings and work windows, and Barlow for reading.
Do preserve native links, forms, visible focus and labeled scroll regions.
Do keep explanations available before, during and after optional motion.
Do reflow entire job records on phones while retaining their information order.
donts: Don't present a planning recommendation as occupational-safety clearance.
Don't blend synthetic examples with retrieved forecast evidence.
Don't turn display status badges into unexplained action chips.
Don't loop motion, delay access or restart a sequence when its replay is activated again while running.
Don't replace the shallow structural depth with large floating shadows.
